description:
Join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Oakland, MD, as an SDC/Infection Control Nurse. This vital role combines staff development and infection prevention, ensuring high standards of care and a safe environment for both residents and staff. You will play a key role in educating our team and implementing robust infection control protocols.

We are seeking a dedicated professional to contribute to our mission of providing exceptional care. This full-time position offers a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42, reflecting your expertise and commitment to quality healthcare. If you are passionate about staff education and maintaining a healthy facility, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Proven experience in staff development and education
Demonstrated experience in infection prevention and control within a healthcare setting
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations related to infection control and staff education
Excellent communication, organizational, and leadership skills
